styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep violet-black backdrop #120A28, glossy plinth violet #4A1FA0, near-white headline text #F2F0FF, muted lilac body text #B9AFDD, and one accent magenta #D624A0; cool low-key tone; backgrounds are seamless violet-black studio cycloramas with at most one graphic layer, either a blue-to-magenta wireframe sound-wave mesh running from #2E6BFF to #D624A0 or a magenta-to-blue halftone dot field; recurring surface is a round violet display podium with a thin raised rim; lighting is a large soft front-left key with a crisp violet rim light, deep falloff at the frame edges, one controlled specular streak on gloss, and a soft contact shadow that grounds the product; modern geometric sans-serif only, oversized two-line headline balanced against the product mass, a thin three-tick rule in #FFFFFF, #E4002B and #FFD400 as the only decorative motif, thin-line monochrome icons and circular plus marks; stable product scale, stable podium height, straight lines and ellipses kept geometrically true; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no added bloom, no watermark, no QR code.

provenance.notes: 源为一张详情页长图的 10 个切片（panel-01 至 panel-10），逐片读取；panel-04 为纯背景过渡、panel-02/03/07/08 上半部为切片边界的背景延续，已合并进相邻镜位，未单独立镜，故 10 片归并为 10 镜中的信息屏结构。形态判定：图中为带拱形头梁与包耳软垫的大耳罩机型，归头戴包耳式；源图末尾参数卡把佩戴方式写成入耳式，与主图形态自相矛盾（疑为套版残留），以图为准取头戴式，L1 手机数码与源夹（数码）相符，L2 取耳机音频。差异化：库内手机数码已有真无线半入耳充电舱、森绿半入耳、带耳翼入耳式有线线控、耳挂式骨传导金属圆盘四版及医药保健助听器一版，均为入耳/半入耳/耳挂形态与浅色或冷白/曜黑视觉体系；本模版落到头戴包耳形态 + 深紫暗调声波网格体系（#120A28 底 / #4A1FA0 展台 / #D624A0 品红线框与点阵波 / 三像素色标 / 竖排细字边饰），与前几版形态和色系均不重复。脱敏与剥离：模板站水印字样、二维码、店铺会员角标、竖排英文边饰文字、模特面孔均未带入；所有精确数值（降噪百分比、电池容量、续航小时、蓝牙版本号、频响范围、阻抗、接口型号、无损格式名称、兼容设备百分比）全部改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位符，需由真实商品资料替换。shot-02 痛点分屏与 shot-08 佩戴场景为标准详情页漏斗屏（首屏承接→痛点放大→机制→利益→对比→场景→参数→收口），源切片未直接出现，按降噪主张与头戴形态合理外推，未添加任何功效或资质类事实声明。
